verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies & Growth practice explicitly offers formation services ('tailored, cost-conscious company formation services... at the earliest stages'), and LathamDrive offers a document generator to 'create the documents necessary to incorporate a company' plus founder-equity glossary terms (vesting, 409A, 83(b)). However, no evidence explicitly names charter, bylaws, board consents, or founder stock purchase agreements as specific deliverables. missing for 10: explicit mention of charter/bylaws/board consents/founder stock purchase agreements as deliverables, client testimonials or case studies of an actual incorporation engagement.
